meta.title: Rules
meta.description: View, create, and edit AGENTS.md inside Settings: project scope follows the workspace directory chain, global scope covers both ~/.dsh and ~/.agents, and third-party tools are managed in per-tool sub-tabs with injected-bytes / character / token stats. The editor has Markdown syntax highlighting and a line-number gutter, the preview renders Markdown, and fullscreen supports side-by-side file compare.
